messages:
incident-bot: automated alert -> p95 latency SLO burning for 12m, p99 spike 3.2x above baseline. Route=/v1/generate, model=redwood-13b-prod, region=eu-west-1. PagerDuty INC199999 triggered. Autopager fired.
pagerduty: Paging eng-oncall -> Alex is primary, Jamal secondary. PLEASE ACK.
ajam: ack (jamal): I'm awake, joining.
alex: ack — I'm on call. Pulling traces and dashboards now.
priya: seeing elevated tail on both host and sidecar latencies, KV cache evictions in the last 10m. Traffic QPS steady.
sasha: adding — recently rolled quantized model variant in eu-west-1 at 07:40; could be related.
priya: yep that rollout had a bug in batching loop, saw a couple of 500ms GC-like pauses on sidecars.
alex: timeline noted. For mitigation: 1) disable new variant rollout 2) increase instance concurrency 3) enable fallback route to stable model.
jamal: I can flip the rollout if you want. Which flag?
priya: rollout id = rollout/2026-03-eu-small-quant. Command: 
``` 
apictl rollout cancel rollout/2026-03-eu-small-quant --region eu-west-1
```
jamal: cancelling rollout now. (ran command)
ops-runbook-bot: Runbook step: "evict-hotkeys" recommended if KV eviction rate > 5/min. Current eviction rate = 12/min.
sasha: we should also ramp sidecar replicas by +20% in eu-west-1 while we stabilize.
alex: scaling sidecars: 
``` 
infractl scale service/redwood-sidecar --region eu-west-1 --pct 20
```
(priya) Initiating warm cache fill for top prefixes — kicking off kvcache-warmjob.
jamal: scaled sidecars and warmed caches. Monitoring.
priya: after cancel + scale, p95 started dropping from 420ms -> 230ms within 30s. p99 still elevated ~900ms.
sasha: creating temporary routing rule to divert 10% traffic to dedicated fallback model (redwood-13b-stable) to reduce tail.
alex: please do. Routing command: 
``` 
routingctl split-traffic --route /v1/generate --region eu-west-1 --variant stable=10,canary=0
```
sasha: applied. Observability: tail latency for route dropped at 1999999030.
priya: customer impact check: alerting says 0.6% of requests hit >1s. No major user-facing errors reported. No SLO breach yet but trending.
jamal: paging notes updated in PD incident -> "mitigations applied: rollout cancelled, sidecars +20%, kvcache warm, 10% traffic routed to stable."
alex: good. Monitoring for 10 more minutes. If p99 remains >800ms we’ll consider autoscaling GPU pool and routing more off canary.
priya: quick note — logs show a hotkey causing frequent KV churn on a single shard (user: acct-8123). I'm throttling their load via rate-limit rule: 
``` 
rlctl set user-rate acct-8123 10r/s
```
jamal: rate-limit applied. KV eviction rate down to 4/min.
alex: p95 at 180ms, p99 at 450ms now. Gradual recovery.
priya: recommended follow-ups: 1) revert canary permanently until further perf testing 2) add preflight for batching loop in canary rollout checks 3) postmortem to review hotkey protections.
sasha: filing a quick follow-up task in #eng-releases for rollout gating.
ajam: any customer comms needed? No alerts from CS so probably internal only.
alex: agree, internal postmortem and runbook update. I'll hand off to Jamal for next hour watch.
ajam: taking watch. Leaving a note in PD: "watching for 30m, escalate to SRE lead if p99 > 800ms."
ops-runbook-bot: Reminder: create postmortem ticket within 48h -> link to template.
alex: closing note — incident resolved, SLO trending back to normal, mitigations worked. Follow-ups: rollback canary permanently, patch batching loop, add hotkey throttles.
priya: thanks team — will draft the postmortem and runbook changes. :thumbsup:
jamal: nice work everyone.
sasha: :party_parrot:
incident-bot: incident closed by alex at 1999999060.
